infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Venting uses the camera only for private video expression recordings that stay on your device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Venting uses the microphone only for private voice vents that stay on your device.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Venting can unlock with Face ID instead of your passcode. Biometrics never leave your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Venting lets you pick photos to keep privately — they stay on your device.
